rules.name: file-500
rules.fix: keep the file at 500 lines or fewer: move a cohesive responsibility into its own module and import it; do not compress lines. Existing long files are named by their exact excess in arch.baseline.json and may only shrink. Kotlin has its own manual ratchet, scripts/check-file-length.sh

rules.name: packages-are-closed
rules.fix: a package reaches another through its published name (@v1d/...), never through a relative path into its files; a relative import that leaves its package is a breach, named in arch.baseline.json and only shrinking
